name: – Monika Hohlmeier – After § 13 – Am 26
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union agencies for the financial year 2024
part_text: 13 a. notes with concern the steady increase in the staffing levels of the Union’s agencies; points out that any increase in staffing levels must be justified by a clearly demonstrated operational need and by measurable results in order to avoid any budgetary overspending;
